arguments.name: nationalityCode
arguments.description: Nationality code to identify the exact record to edit (e.g., "000208"). If this is provided, the tool edits that record directly and does not ask about duplicates.

raw.name: nationalityCode
raw.description: Nationality code to identify the exact record to edit (e.g., "000208"). If this is provided, the tool edits that record directly and does not ask about duplicates.

arguments.name: nationalityName
arguments.description: New nationality name to be saved.

raw.name: nationalityName
raw.description: New nationality name to be saved.

arguments.name: searchNationalityName
arguments.description: Existing nationality name to identify the record when the code is not provided. If multiple records share the same name, the tool returns all matches and asks the user which code to edit.

raw.name: searchNationalityName
raw.description: Existing nationality name to identify the record when the code is not provided. If multiple records share the same name, the tool returns all matches and asks the user which code to edit.

arguments.name: applyTo
arguments.description:
Controls what to do when multiple records match the same searchNationalityName.
Allowed values:
"single" (default) — return matches and ask the user which nationalityCode to edit
"all" — update all matching records with the new nationalityName

raw.name: applyTo

arguments.name: pageSize
arguments.description: Page size to use for the results grid (must match UI behavior). Default: "10"
